value.name: associates react confusedly
value.description: The young associates appear confused by Miles's moralizing speech.

value.name: wrigley asks about extinguishing
value.description: Wrigley raises his hand and asks a question about 'Extinguish?' in response to Miles's speech.
evidence: Wrigley raises his hand. WRIGLEY Extinguish?

value.name: miles contrasts fear and trust
value.description: Miles challenges the associates to choose trust over fear and building over destruction in client relationships.
evidence: MILES Should we counsel fear -- or trust? Should we seek to destroy -- or to build? Should we meet our clients' problems with cynicism -- or with love?

value.name: kramer answers build
value.description: Miles calls on Kramer, who answers that the choice is to build.
evidence: MILES (another raised hand) Kramer? KRAMER Build?

value.name: miles declares leap of love
value.description: Miles says the decision is each person's, and he declares that he has made the leap of love with no return.
evidence: MILES The decision of course, is each of ours. For my part, I have made the leap of love, and there is no going back

value.name: herb watches silently
value.description: Herb Myserson sits in the back of the room, silently observing Miles's speech while breathing heavily.
evidence: Herb Myserson sits in the back of the room. He watches, breathing heavily.
